old_problem: The source names RecEn[2] but gives no RecCtrl definition or safe mask, no errortype2 meaning, retry count/timing, or deterministic recovered-versus-exhausted/reset/BERT outcome.
disposition_reason: UECC retry is a recovery feature whose acceptance depends on the raw register contract and branch policy. Generic AMD RAS knowledge cannot define RecEn[2] for this CPU/tool revision or whether errortype2 should recover, exhaust, reset or emit BERT. ED-16 prohibits both the register modification and injection without exact rollback/recovery. This is a genuine Pending/BLOCKED engineering-spec gap.
decision_basis: Read Reliability row54, AI fields, historical record2456, baseline row55 context and next pending row56.
Preserved UECC Retry/RecEn[2], errortype2, per-slot and reset/BERT coverage independently of parity CE/UCE rows.
Required raw before/target/after register values and writable mask.
Made retry attempt/count/result evidence distinct from final BERT outcome.
No register write, BIOS/HDT change, injection or reset occurred.

test_case.test_name: AMD DRAM UECC retry with recovered and exhausted branches
test_case.purpose: For every approved memory target, prove RecEn[2]-controlled UECC retry attempts the documented count and follows the platform-defined recovery or exhaustion/reset/BERT branch.
required_package: RecCtrl register definition, writable mask and RecEn[2] access method
Retry count/timing and deterministic branch matrix
OOB/BERT recovery and exact raw-register/BIOS/HDT restoration
test_case.test_command: Do not modify RecCtrl or inject. After approval, capture the full raw register, change only RecEn[2] using the documented mask, verify it, inject one mapped target under OOB capture, record retry attempt/count/result, follow the signed recovered or exhausted/reset branch, then clear injection and restore/compare the full register and platform state.
test_case.expected_result: The mapped target performs the specified retry count/timing and matches exactly one approved branch: successful recovery with healthy memory, or bounded exhaustion/reset with matching BERT/CPER and successful boot recovery; RecCtrl returns exactly to baseline.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: No PASS exists until the register and branch matrix are authoritative. RecEn[2]=1 alone, tool PASS, BERT alone, absence of reset without retry evidence or altered adjacent bits cannot pass.
safety_gate: Dedicated backed-up ECC SUT with OOB boot/reimage recovery.
No register write without definition, mask and saved full value.
One target; abort on retry loop, wrong target, storm, fatal escalation, boot failure or persistent UECC.
No automatic retry; clear injector and restore raw state.
expected_evidence: Versioned RecCtrl/RecEn[2] definition and flag contract
Slot map and raw before/target/after values
Full injection and retry counter/timing record
Memory/boot health, exact restoration and verdict
test_case.recovery: The owner must specify both retry-success cleanup and retry-exhaustion reset/power/reimage paths, including restoration of the full register. Execution remains blocked until every branch is recoverable.
